author: theeazye
quote: As someone who grew up with GTA, learned English with GTA, and lived with GTA, I ABSOLUTELY DID NOT LIKE this game. Leaving aside the 30FPS issue. The story is the worst GTA story **** Vice City in the game doesn't feel like the OG Vice City at all. The map is empty, the main characters are very boring, and the side characters are incredibly bad.There wasn't a SINGLE scene in the game that made me laugh. Humor is 0.I still don't understand why the game was given a 99. The animations are like "Sliding on Ice".
